thread:
mel: Heads-up — ACME pilot wants guaranteed 50k qps for inference in staging next month. Need to align on what we can commit for prewarm/burst and what the runtime/infrastructure tradeoffs are. Who's free for a quick triage?
aj (eng-runtime): I can join. Quick Q: is 50k qps steady or burst?
mel: Mostly bursty — expected spike windows when onboarding; baseline is ~5-10k. They want <100ms p95 for short prompts.
priya (eng-infra): 50k burst is non-trivial. We need to know GPU types, shard counts, and whether Dedicated or Hosted.
mel: They're on a Dedicated trial. Prefer to avoid changing plans mid-pilot.
aj (eng-runtime): OK. For <100ms p95 at 50k burst we need more than just batching — will require aggressive prefix caching and a warm KV cache. Also model variant quantization might help.
sam (security): Also flagging HSM/KMS constraints: ACME requires envelope encryption with their KMS. That affects startup time for fresh nodes.
lucy (sre): Prewarm strategy: we can maintain a pool of warm workers but that impacts cost. We should simulate cost across prewarm levels. I can mock a traffic generator.
mel: Goals for this thread: 1) decide SLOs we can commit 2) list infra/runtime changes needed 3) estimate lift and cost. Can we get a decision in 48h?
aj (eng-runtime): Actionable items from runtime: - Add prefix/KV caching policy for tenant - Add quantized model build for 8-bit variant - Validate continuous batching thresholds and fallback to smaller batch sizes under latency pressure
priya (eng-infra): Infra asks: - Reserve burst pool: 10 extra GPUs in Dedicated pool - Network egress tuning for region - Validate autoscaler prewarm hooks + KMS integration test (sam)
sam (security): I'll scope KMS onboarding: expected 3 workdays for policy & HSM config, plus integration test time. If we need HSM-backed keys on node boot, that can add ~30-60s cold start latency.
lucy (sre): Can we compromise: keep a smaller warm pool + fast autoscale to burst with graceful degradation policy? If burst misses, fallback to a cheaper model variant.
aj (eng-runtime): That fallback path is doable: runtime can route to a lower-cost quantized variant automatically and annotate responses with "x-fallback-model" header for product telemetry.
mel: Nice — product needs the telemetry so SRE/Product can measure experience impact. Add that to acceptance criteria.
deploy-bot: Reminder: weekly deploy freeze Thu 17:00 - Fri 09:00 UTC. Any infra changes touching autoscaler may need staging hotfix window.
mel: Proposed next step: 1) aj + priya + sam + lucy do a 30m sync today to sketch the plan 2) priya to run cost sim by EOD tomorrow 3) sam to confirm KMS impact and blockers 4) aj to prototype fallback routing and quant build.
aj (eng-runtime): I can demo a simple prefix cache + fallback in dev by tomorrow.
priya (eng-infra): I'll run the cost sim and a quick autoscaler smoke test tomorrow morning.
sam (security): I'll post KMS onboarding checklist here after sync.
lucy (sre): I'll queue a load test for Friday (if it doesn't hit deploy freeze) or next Monday.
mel: Great. I'll consolidate and set decision checkpoint for 48h. If any blocker, flag here with :rotating_light:. Thanks everyone.
aj (eng-runtime): +1
priya (eng-infra): 👍
sam (security): ✅
lucy (sre): :rocket:"
